summary: I’m a Licensed Professional Teacher teaching high school science and research at Colegio de Sto. Tomas-Recoletos, Incorporated.
bio:
I earned my Bachelor of Secondary Education, major in Science, at Central Philippines State University’s San Carlos Campus. During my 360-hour teaching placement at Julio Ledesma National High School, I designed and delivered science lessons under supervision.

I co-authored an undergraduate study on briquettes made from agricultural residues. My continuing professional learning connects that interest in applied science with classroom practice, including explicit instruction, feedback, action research, and the responsible use of technology and AI.
